regions.merged_text: Hopelessness Brings Hope & Conversion: Joseph Guarnieri 24 re- ported hopelessly dying in Providence with complication - kidney trouble principally - is enrolled on St. Joseph's Day by his chum-friend "Edw'd" Kozak at the time a Russellite, who promises to do something specially pleasing to God, if his friend is spared. Two days later he phones that the patient is back to consciousness and able to talk. A week elapses and he phones his friend is actually reading the news-papers and feeling fine. Next day makes profession of faith, adjures heresy and returns after 7 years to reception of the Holy Sacraments. Thanks be to God. June 13th Both young men come to Mon- astery To-day healthy and happy. Thanks be to God.

regions.merged_text: Curviture of Spine & Paralisis Cured: Mildred Kirchoff (25) of 5737 Seminole had a bad fall when 9 years old. Four years later it began to affect her spine, leaving her badly deformed & para- lized. After doctring and suffering for seven years she was en- rolled in S.M.Assoc. in May last year. To-day, a picture of health, she is teaching in physical training school. Thanks be to God!

regions.merged_text: Brain-Tumer. Marian Velten 13, of 1470 Helen Ave. ailing two years prepared yesterday in Hen. Ford's Hospital since last Tuesday - head shaven and on operating table for operation on Tumer of the Brain - her Brother Edward and her Father ready to give blood for "transfusion" if required in case she bled too freely. At this junctur the speaker for 9 doctors comes out and anounces a seeming change in location of tumer or possibly two tumers and therefore, "No operation To-day." She is enrolled this A.M. perpetually by poor anxious Mother - at 9.30 .... Next day Apr. 15th 7.15 p.m. Father & Brother report "Marion home To- day, Evidently improving. All hope now that no operation will be necessary . P.S. Oct. 7
